# TimeUnit { #timetoalign.TimeUnit }

```python
TimeUnit()
```

Units of measurement for coordinates.

Organized by domain. Each unit belongs to a specific domain.
Aliases are provided for common abbreviations.

| [resolve_number_type](#timetoalign.TimeUnit.resolve_number_type) | Return the numeric representation to use for this unit. |

### resolve_number_type { #timetoalign.TimeUnit.resolve_number_type }

```python
TimeUnit.resolve_number_type(requested=None)
```

Return the numeric representation to use for this unit.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                                                                      | Description                                                          | Default   |
|-----------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| requested | [NumberType](`timetoalign.core.enums.NumberType`) \| [str](`str`) \| None | An explicit choice, or ``None`` to take :attr:`default_number_type`. | `None`    |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                              | Description                       |
|--------|---------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------|
|        | [NumberType](`timetoalign.core.enums.NumberType`) | The resolved :class:`NumberType`. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                               |
|--------|----------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If *requested* is not among :attr:`allowed_number_types`. |
